column1: # Lucene 10.5.0 lucene-spatial3d: every top-level class of the jar, and what became of it.
# Checked by scripts/check-port-inventory.py --module spatial3d (see its docstring for the statuses).

column3: crates/lucene-index/src/document/geo3d.rs::Geo3DPoint -- its query factories are lucene-search document/geo/geo3d.rs::geo3d_point
crates/lucene-search/src/document/geo/sort.rs::Geo3DDistance -- each document's own values are read (Lucene's re-reads a multi-valued document's values in copy(); see docs/parity.md)

crates/lucene-search/src/document/geo/geo3d.rs::from_polygon -- with from_large_polygon, from_path, from_distance, from_box, decode_value_floor/ceil; fromDegrees is lucene-index document/geo3d.rs::from_degrees

crates/lucene-search/src/document/geo/geo3d.rs::PointInGeo3DShapeQuery -- the search (BKD walk, M9), equals (PartialEq), hashCode, toString(field), ramBytesUsed (64-bit compressed-oops sizes) and visit (a leaf on its field); the shapes' equals/hashCode/toString are GeoShape::java_equals/java_hash_code/java_to_string; fixture GenGeo3dObjects
crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/distance_style.rs::DistanceStyle -- the five Java distance classes are one enum; this is DistanceStyle::Arc
crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/shape.rs::PlanetObject -- the abstract base is the trait
crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/xyz_solid.rs::XYZSolid -- the shared solid code is free functions beside the trait
crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/shape.rs::base_get_relationship -- the abstract base as a free function
crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/shape.rs::base_get_bounds -- the abstract base as a free function
crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/geo_composite.rs::composite_area_shape -- the generic bases are one macro per member interface
crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/geo_composite.rs::composite_shape -- the generic bases are one macro per member interface
crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/geo_composite.rs::composite_shape -- the generic bases are one macro per member interface
crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/shape.rs::impl_distance_shape -- the abstract base as a macro
crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/shape.rs::impl_membership_shape -- the abstract base as a macro
crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/shape.rs::base_get_bounds -- the abstract base as a free function

crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/geo_standard_path.rs::GeoStandardPath -- PathNode.pathDistance and PathNode.fullPathDistance are not ported: unreachable in Java (GeoStandardPath never calls pathDistance on rootComponent, only PathNode.pathDistance itself does, and the previous component whose fullPathDistance an end point or segment reads is never a PathNode)
crates/lucene-spatial3d/src/shape.rs::SerializableObject -- the stream helpers are serializable.rs and standard_objects.rs
